description: Boot Phoenix endpoint and verify GET /healthz returns {"status":"ok"} with Content-Type application/json

steps.name: start-server
steps.shell: cd elixir && MIX_ENV=test nohup mix run --no-start ../.opal/healthz_server.exs > /tmp/opal_healthz.log 2>&1 & SERVER_PID=$!; disown $SERVER_PID; echo $SERVER_PID > /tmp/opal_healthz_pid.txt; for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -fs http://localhost:41777/healthz > /dev/null 2>&1 && exit 0; sleep 1; done; cat /tmp/opal_healthz.log >&2; exit 1
